name: Main Street Yield
oneLiner: msY was Main Street's ERC-4626-style strategy vault over msUSD; Pharos freezes it after the parent msUSD collapse in June 2026.

obituary.epitaph: The wrapper followed the parent down
obituary.obituary: msY is a strategy-vault wrapper over msUSD, so the June 2026 msUSD collapse impaired the wrapper's durable dollar backing. As msUSD depegged after Accountable terminated reserve verification, msY also traded far below its prior net-asset value and could not recover independently from the parent asset. Pharos freezes msY with msUSD as a derivative collapse rather than treating the vault share as an active stablecoin-like dollar instrument.
obituary.sourceLabel: Protos Main Street vault collapse report

collateral: msUSD strategy vault shares backed by Main Street's delta-neutral options and derivatives strategy reserve; exchange-rate gains accrue to msY holders
pegMechanism: ERC-4626-style staking token over msUSD; users stake msUSD for msY, whose exchange rate appreciates with strategy returns, while final USDC redemption inherits Main Street's primary-market caps and cooldowns

mintAuthority.summary: msY is an ERC-4626-style strategy wrapper over Main Street USD. Wrapper minting creates msY shares against deposited MSUSD, while durable base-dollar issuance is inherited from the reviewed MSUSD parent.

controls.label: msY ERC-4626-style wrapper
controls.capDescription: The wrapper mints msY shares through deposit/mint flows against MSUSD asset deposits; it does not mint base MSUSD.

review.evidence: Local variant metadata, parent MSUSD mintAuthority, and Ethereum RPC/source reads show msY as a wrapper over MSUSD rather than a separate base stablecoin mint path. At block 25295174: Safe API confirmed guard=0x0 (no guard), enabledModules=[], threshold=3 of 4 owners. The owner Safe has parameter-only influence (deposit toggles and cooldown settings); share issuance follows only MSUSD deposits into the vault.
